Make a precise painted-over version of IMAGE 1, the technical floor layout. IMAGE 1 IS THE EDIT TARGET. Preserve its exact spatial composition and silhouettes. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for hand-painted materials, sunlight and blue-white-gold Gothic floating-city style. DO NOT copy, borrow, infer, align to, or preserve Image 2's wrong floor layout.

This is a pixel-registered production game background, 1536x1024 RGB landscape. The fixed cream-colored region of Image 1 is the complete legal walkable top face. Paint that exact region as beautiful bright ivory stone paving. Do not change even one segment's position, length, corner, asymmetry, overall scale or hole. Do not recompose the scene. Keep Image 1's blue sky hole and blue exterior in their exact existing positions. All diagram text, red circles and blue outlined rectangle are technical marks to REMOVE; underneath every such mark on cream is continuous unobstructed paving. There must be no guide marks or labels in the finished art.

ABSOLUTE 1536x1024 ground-top OUTER silhouette, clockwise in pixel coordinates:
(246,360) → (460,360) → (460,327) → (494,327) → (494,251) → (1093,251) → (1093,360) → (1290,360) → (1290,672) → (956,672) → (956,617) → (580,617) → (580,672) → (246,672) → close.
Preserve that exact asymmetrical polygon. Notice the left upper shoulder has an extra step, while the right upper shoulder is a direct descent at x1093 to y360. Do not symmetrize it or add a right-side step.
Its exact normalized source union is six rectangles (x,y,width,height):
(0.1601428571,0.352,0.2172857143,0.3042222222),
(0.344,0.4383333333,0.312,0.1644444444),

THE BLUE HOLE inside this ground is exactly x631..905,y411..449; normalized x0.410857..0.589143,y0.401333..0.438333. Paint airy blue/white sky through it. No ground, water, roof or obstruction there. The hole must stay perfectly horizontal in its registered location.
Check especially: west edge x246, east edge1290; northern floor row251; southern left/right floor row672; central recessed south row617. These are anchors, not approximate suggestions.

ART DIRECTION: use Image 2 only for bright hand-painted cartoon fantasy art and coherent 2.5D materials. Ivory paving across the entire exact cream footprint, quiet low-contrast pale-gold feather/wing inlays, directional hand-painted stone texture, soft sunny highlights. Every legal top-face pixel must remain flat playable paving. The fixed screen-space silhouette is axis aligned; do not perspective-warp, tilt, rotate, round or trapezoid it. Express the high three-quarter overhead view using texture direction, visible roof planes, lighting, and the deep vertical architecture OUTSIDE the floor boundary. No stairs, height breaks, walls, pillars, planters, shrubs, tower bases, fences, railings or objects on or over the legal ground.

SURROUNDINGS: Transform blue exterior into a complete coherent winged Gothic cloud city environment. White-stone/azure/gold pointed towers and chapel scenery compose in the upper external region, well behind and outside the floor. Deep Gothic arch ribs and floating cliffs hang below the EXACT south boundaries, with greenery and waterfalls down their vertical faces. Soft clouds provide clear negative space around the top-face contour. Foundations must read as vertical deep volume, never as extra top-face floor. Tiny distant cloud islands and a winged airship can occupy the far sky. Do not attach another path, forecourt, walkway or gangway anywhere. No foreground walkable-looking paving outside the exact cream mask.

Keep the floor boundary extremely legible, with a thin white carved lip only on the exterior side of the edge. Do not add tall balustrades, posts, column feet or planting at the boundary. The sky slit has no thick raised rim. Keep all supplied red-marker positions as EMPTY paving after removing the markers; do not generate their named props. No actor, enemy, hero, flag, vane, exit portal, banner, warning, wind effect, arrow, HUD, text or watermark.

The desired result is IMAGE 1's exact floor mask beautifully painted into an integrated original fantasy room, using IMAGE 2's art quality. It is not an edit of Image 2. Never use Image 2's footprint. Deliver only the finished single complete background, no diagram borders or reference collage.
